title: openetl platform event
description: The body of a webhook's delivery of one platform event, laid out as Standard Webhooks says. Resources are named as the API names them, such as `workspaces/default/pipelines/shop`.

timestamp.description: When the event was recorded, in RFC 3339.

data.description: The event's details. What it holds depends on `type`, as the sections below say.

then.description: A sync, or a continuous pipeline's run, started.
A sync, or a continuous pipeline's run, ended without an error.
A sync, or a continuous pipeline's run, failed. `error` says why, and `code` is the error's code if it has one.
A sync, or a continuous pipeline's run, was stopped before it ended.
A pipeline was applied for the first time.
A new version of a pipeline was applied.
A pipeline was deleted.

data.description: The pipeline, and its last version.

then.description: What a deleted pipeline's connector or Flink cluster kept for it couldn't be removed after 7 days of trying, and is left for someone to remove.

data.description: The pipeline, by its name alone, with `connector` and `error`.

then.description: A pipeline was paused, by someone or by a playbook.

data.description: The pipeline, with its `version` if someone paused it, or the `incident` if a playbook did.

then.description: A pipeline was resumed.
A continuous pipeline's read fell further behind its source than its threshold.
A continuous pipeline that was lagging caught up, to within half its threshold.

data.description: How far behind it is now, and since when it had been lagging.

then.description: A pipeline's jobs were rescaled, through the API or by the job loop. A running job stops at a checkpoint and starts again at the new size.
Heal set an override of a field of the pipeline's spec, or someone removed one.

data.description: The pipeline, with `field` and `value`, and the `incident` if a playbook set it.

then.description: One of a pipeline's streams was paused on its own, by someone or by a playbook.

data.description: The pipeline, with `stream`, and the `incident` if a playbook paused it.

then.description: One of a pipeline's streams was resumed.
A pipeline's streams are to be read again from the start.

data.description: The pipeline and its version, with `streams`, or none for every stream.

then.description: A stream's schema has a new version.

data.description: The new schema, and how it differs from the one before.

then.description: A sync or run failed because of a schema change it can't take. It comes with that sync's `sync.failed`.
An incident opened.
An open incident became critical.
An incident was resolved.
Sent to one webhook when it's tested, such as by `openetl webhook test`.

sync.description: A sync, or a continuous pipeline's run.

version.description: The version of the pipeline it ran.

continuous.description: Whether it's a continuous pipeline's run, not a scheduled sync.

endTime.description: When it ended, in RFC 3339. Left out until it has.

error.description: What it failed with. Left out if it didn't.

code.description: The error's code, such as `SCHEMA_DRIFT`. Left out if it has none.

pipeline.description: A pipeline, and what changed about it.
The pipeline's resource name. In `pipeline.teardown_failed`, its name alone, as the pipeline no longer exists.

provenance.description: Where the version came from, such as `cli:shop.yaml#3`.

incident.description: The resource name of the incident a playbook paused the pipeline or stream, or overrode its spec, for.

connector.description: The source, destination or Flink cluster a failed teardown was for.

error.description: What the teardown last failed with.

field.description: The field of the spec that's overridden.

value.description: The override's value, as JSON. Left out once it's removed.

streams.description: The streams a reset reads again. Left out for every stream.

lag.description: How far a continuous pipeline's read is behind its source.

lagSeconds.description: How far behind the read is, in seconds.

thresholdSeconds.description: How far behind counts as lagging, in seconds.

since.description: When it started lagging, in RFC 3339.

stream.description: The stream furthest behind. Left out for the whole read.

size.description: The size the API set, such as `l` or `3 vCPU, 6 GiB`. Left out when the job loop rescaled it, or the API gave the spec back its say.

lanes.description: The lanes the job loop set.

fromLanes.description: The lanes of the job it rescaled.

output.description: Whether the stream is one of a transform's outputs.

columns.description: Every column of the new schema.

added.description: The names of the columns added.

removed.description: The names of the columns removed.

changed.description: The names of the columns whose type or nullability changed.

column.description: A column of a stream's schema.

stream.description: The stream it's about. Left out for the whole pipeline.

class.description: What kind of incident it is, such as `auth` or `crash_loop`.

code.description: The error's code, if it came from one.

fingerprint.description: What identifies the fault across pipelines.

occurrences.description: How many times it has happened.

sync.description: The resource name of the sync it came from.

firstSeenTime.description: When it first happened, in RFC 3339.

lastSeenTime.description: When it last happened, in RFC 3339.

resolveTime.description: When it was resolved, in RFC 3339. Left out until it is.
